name: player_destroyed_state_reset_finalize_callback
description: Player::DestroyedStateResetFinalizeCallback finalizes destroyed-state respawn reset, optionally moving a player away from a nearby higher-priority spawn occupant, then restoring local lifecycle, health, and camera transition state. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player destroyed-state/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41bca0 validates ECX as zUtil_SaveGameState*, nearest-save-state scratch initialized from the input, player/master data loads, GetNearestOtherPlayerDistanceToSpawnPoint using playerState->worldPos as the spawn-point position view, the 20.0f nearest-distance gate, lower playerColorIndex respawn check, optional GameNet::RespawnPlayerAndDropWeaponPickupIfAllowed(saveState, 0), DestroyedStateResetLocalFinalize call, lifecycleState reset to 1, statusMeterValue restored from masterCommonData->maxHealth, and cameraTransitionTimer zeroing.

The native smoke verifies the no-near-player path restores lifecycle, full health, camera transition timer, steering state, and the HUD/status-meter side effects delegated through DestroyedStateResetLocalFinalize.
